name: Serpent Night Dragon
extDescription: A dragon created from the soul of a wicked knight.

name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Petit Moth" on your 6th turn or later after it was equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

name: Barrel Dragon
extDescription: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; toss a coin 3 times and destroy it if at least 2 of the results are heads.

name: Amazoness Swords Woman
extDescription: Your opponent takes Any battle damage you Would Have taken from Battles Involving this card instead.

name: King of the Skull Servants
extDescription: The original ATK of this card is the combined number of "King of the Skull Servants" and "Skull Servant" in your GY x 1000. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can banish 1 other "King of the Skull Servants" or 1 "Skull Servant" from your GY; Special Summon this card.

name: Fortress Whale
extDescription: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Fortress Whale's Oath".

name: Kabazauls
extDescription: A huge monster in the shape of a hippopotamus. The sneezing from his gigantic body is so fierce that people mistake it for a hurricane.

name: Man-Eater Bug
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

name: The Legendary Fisherman
extDescription: While "Umi" is on the field, this card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

name: Hyper Hammerhead
extDescription: At the end of the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster that battled this card is not destroyed: Return that opponent's monster to the hand .

name: Ally of Justice Core Destroyer
extDescription: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a LIGHT monster: Destroy that monster.

name: Beetron
extDescription: You can send 1 face-up Spell/Trap you control to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Insect monster in your GY; Special Summon that Insect monster in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Beetron" once per turn.

name: Slushy
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send 1 "Slushy" from your Deck to the GY. If you have 3 copies of "Slushy" total, either banished and/or in your GY (combined): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 5 or higher Sea Serpent monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. You can only use this effect of "Slushy" once per turn.

name: Enchanting Fitting Room
extDescription: Pay 800 LP; excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck and Special Summon all excavated Level 3 or lower Normal Monsters, also, after that, shuffle the rest back into your Deck.

name: Summoner's Art
extDescription: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Half Shut
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it cannot be destroyed by battle this turn, also its ATK is halved until the end of this turn.

name: Ready for Intercepting
extDescription: Target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

name: Adhesion Trap Hole
extDescription: When your opponent Summons a monster(s): Halve that monster(s)'s original ATK.

name: Speed Duel: Tournament Pack 2
extDescription: Each promotional pack contains 2 random cards.
